ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising_edge timing for all clocked processes; drives pointer registers, memory/reg writes, read-pointer flop and synchronous output updates such as r_pnt_ff and sync_status outputs.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in pointer_reg, write_* processes, async_r_pnt_reg, sync_read_large and sync_status processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous reset input that initializes pointer registers and, when present, clears memory/registers and synchronous status outputs in clocked processes' reset branches.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in pointer_reg, write_reset_* and sync_status processes

ports.name: clear_i
ports.functionality: When asserted forces combinational next-pointer values (w_nxt, r_nxt) to zero, causing pointers to be cleared on the next clock edge.
ports.evidence: when (clear_i = '1') branches in concurrent assignments to w_nxt and r_nxt

ports.name: half_o
ports.functionality: Reports the internally computed half condition (from level or full). It is driven either directly from internal half (combinational) or registered into the port synchronously depending on FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: half_o <= half (async branch) and sync_status process assigns half_o <= half on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: level_o
ports.functionality: Outputs the internal level vector zero-extended into the 32-bit port; composed combinationally from internal level bits.
ports.evidence: level_extend process assigns level_o(level'left downto 0) <= level(...) and sets others to '0'

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: Carries write payload from external producer and feeds write processes; stored into fifo_reg or fifo_mem on clocked writes when we is asserted.
ports.evidence: fifo_reg <= wdata_i and fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i in write_* processes (clocked)

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: External write request input; combined with safety logic to produce internal we, which gates memory/register writes.
ports.evidence: we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free)

ports.name: free_o
ports.functionality: Reports internal free (not-full) status to external users; driven either combinationally or registered depending on FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: free_o <= free (async branch) and sync_status process assigns free_o <= free on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: re_i
ports.functionality: External read request input; combined with safety logic and avail to produce internal re, which enables pointer advancement and read operations.
ports.evidence: re <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail)

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: Provides FIFO output words from storage; driven either directly from fifo_reg/fifo_mem (async) or registered from memory on clock edge (sync), indexed by r_pnt or r_pnt_ff.
ports.evidence: rdata_o <= fifo_reg (small) or fifo_mem(...) (async); sync_read_large process assigns rdata_o <= fifo_mem(...) on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: avail_o
ports.functionality: Reports internal avail (not-empty) status to external users; driven either combinationally or registered depending on FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: avail_o <= avail (async branch) and sync_status process assigns avail_o <= avail on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: fifo_mem
signals.functionality: Array storage that holds written words indexed by the write pointer and read via the read pointer; written on clock when we='1' and read combinationally or synchronously for rdata_o.
signals.evidence: fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i in write_* processes; rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(...))) in read assignments

signals.name: fifo_reg
signals.functionality: Holds the single FIFO word for depth=1 configurations; written on clock when we='1' and read to rdata_o.
signals.evidence: fifo_reg <= wdata_i in write_small / write_reset_small processes; rdata_o <= fifo_reg in small read branches

signals.name: we
signals.functionality: Derived internal write enable produced from we_i and free (when FIFO_SAFE); used to gate clocked writes into fifo_reg/fifo_mem.
signals.evidence: we <= we_i ... else (we_i and free); if (we = '1') then fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i / fifo_reg <= wdata_i

signals.name: re
signals.functionality: Derived internal read enable from re_i and avail when FIFO_SAFE; used to gate pointer increment (r_nxt) and thereby control reads.
signals.evidence: re <= re_i ... else (re_i and avail); r_nxt uses when (re = '1') to select incremented value

signals.name: match
signals.functionality: Indicates whether write and read pointer lower bits match; computed from w_pnt and r_pnt and used to determine full and empty status.

signals.name: empty
signals.functionality: Reflects FIFO empty condition computed from pointer MSBs and match; used to derive avail (not-empty).
signals.evidence: empty <= '1' when (r_pnt(...) = w_pnt(...)) and (match = '1') else '0'; avail <= not empty

signals.name: full
signals.functionality: Reflects FIFO full condition computed from pointer MSBs and match; used to compute free and half signals.
signals.evidence: full <= '1' when (r_pnt(...) /= w_pnt(...)) and (match = '1') else '0'; free <= not full

signals.name: half
signals.functionality: Computed from the high bit of level or full; drives half_o and participates in status reporting.
signals.evidence: half <= level(level'left-1) or full; half_o <= half (async) or assigned in sync_status

signals.name: free
signals.functionality: Computed as the complement of full and used to gate writes (when FIFO_SAFE) and exported to free_o.
signals.evidence: free <= not full; we <= ... else (we_i and free); free_o <= free (async) or in sync_status

signals.name: avail
signals.functionality: Computed as the complement of empty and used to gate reads (when FIFO_SAFE) and exported to avail_o.
signals.evidence: avail <= not empty; re <= ... else (re_i and avail); avail_o <= avail (async) or in sync_status

signals.name: w_pnt
signals.functionality: Registered write pointer capturing w_nxt on clock edge; used to index writes into memory and to compute level, match, full and empty.
role: SOURCES write index and status logic
signals.evidence: pointer_reg process assigns w_pnt <= w_nxt; w_nxt/std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt)+1) and fifo_mem indexed by w_pnt in write processes; match/level use w_pnt

signals.name: w_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for the write pointer; increments from w_pnt when we='1' or clears to zero when clear_i is asserted.
signals.evidence: w_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ... std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt)+1) when (we='1') else w_pnt; pointer_reg captures w_nxt

signals.name: r_pnt
signals.functionality: Registered read pointer capturing r_nxt on clock edge; used to index reads from memory and to compute level, match, full and empty.
role: SOURCES read index and status logic
signals.evidence: pointer_reg assigns r_pnt <= r_nxt; r_nxt uses r_pnt, fifo_mem indexed by r_pnt in sync read, match/level use r_pnt

signals.name: r_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for the read pointer; increments r_pnt when re='1' or clears to zero when clear_i is asserted.
signals.evidence: r_nxt <= (others=>'0') when clear_i='1' else std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(r_pnt)+1) when (re='1') else r_pnt; pointer_reg captures r_nxt

signals.name: r_pnt_ff
signals.functionality: Registered copy of r_nxt used by the asynchronous read path to index fifo_mem for rdata_o; updated on rising clock edge in async read branch.
signals.evidence: async_r_pnt_reg process assigns r_pnt_ff <= r_nxt; rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt_ff(...))))

signals.name: level
signals.functionality: Combinational vector computed as unsigned(w_pnt)-unsigned(r_pnt); used to compute half and exported via level_o.
signals.evidence: level <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt)); level_extend process assigns level_o from level; half uses level bits
